dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: The clouds are like picture frames in the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: If I had wisdom to rival the gods, could I, too, draw pictures in the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello...?

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, I doubt it.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: The heavens are above the gods, and the stars are above the heavens...

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: ...Nothing is truly omnipotent.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's no getting through to this person... Never mind.)

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Hello there. Did Setaria send you over?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Setaria?

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, my bad. I've only recently returned to the Akademiya from Aaru Village, so very few people speak to me. I subconsciously assumed that you're one of Setaria's friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you've got the wrong person.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Ah! Um, sorry about that! I presumed too much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aaru Village, you say...

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: That's right. I was previously one of the Village Keepers... That's what the villagers told me, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Village Keepers are researchers who have been exiled to Aaru Village. But in truth, I don't really remember what I did there.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: It's almost like I had a dream that I no longer remembered once I awoke... and yet my mind is still quite clear.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Later, a lady named Setaria helped me settle some procedures that would let me return to the Akademiya. Honestly, it was a lot of procedures indeed, so I'm quite thankful for her help.

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: She should be busy here with her work as an educator at the moment. I plan on helping her to look for some necessary materials, such as books about basic infrastructure...

dialogues.speaker: Fargana
dialogues.text: Once I've finished settling those things, I'll contact her again.
